requirement.summary: Report - TMS020 Waiting List Report - Add Syndicate Owner Indicator field
requirement.description:
User Story

As a TMS report user, I want the Syndicate Owner Indicator field displayed in the TMS020 Waiting List Report so that I can identify the syndicate ownership type of each reservation directly from the report without cross-referencing other systems.

Current Behavior

The TMS020 Waiting List Report does not display the Syndicate Owner Indicator field. The field was added to the TMS reservation record (ref. HERO-64070, HERO-67705) but is not yet surfaced in this report.

Expected Behavior

The TMS020 Waiting List Report displays the Syndicate Owner Indicator field immediately to the LEFT of the "Syndicate Owner" field. The field appears in both the on-screen report view and the printed/exported output. The report layout may reflow freely to accommodate the new column.

The field reads from DB field hkjc_resv_members: rmem_syndicate_owner_indicator and displays as follows:

- Y = Yes (display as "Y")

- N = No (display as "N")

- empty = reservation uses an offline profile with no Syndicate Owner Indicator (display as blank)

Acceptance Criteria

Display Syndicate Owner Indicator column

- Given the TMS020 Waiting List Report is generated

- When the report is displayed on screen

- Then a Syndicate Owner Indicator column appears immediately to the LEFT of the Syndicate Owner column

- And the column is also present in the printed/exported output in the same position

Show indicator value

- Given the TMS020 Waiting List Report is generated

- When the report renders reservations with varying rmem_syndicate_owner_indicator values

- Then a reservation with value Y displays "Y"

- And a reservation with value N displays "N"

- But a reservation with an empty value (offline profile with no indicator) displays blank

Preserve data integrity on layout reflow

- Given the Syndicate Owner Indicator column is added to the report

- When the report is rendered on screen or exported/printed

- Then the layout reflows freely to fit the new column

- And no existing column data is truncated or hidden as a result of the reflow

- But if the report width cannot accommodate the new column without truncation, the export/print output still includes the full Syndicate Owner Indicator value

Supporting Evidence

DB field: hkjc_resv_members: rmem_syndicate_owner_indicator (to be confirmed with TMS team)

Related tickets:

- HERO-64070

- HERO-67705

Note: This ticket is scoped to TMS020 only. The other 9 reports (TMS009, TMS015, TMS016, TMS022, TMS024, TMS025, TMS035, TMS037, TMS039) require separate tickets.

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: Not specified

Notes: No deadline provided by requester

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Background

Syndicate Owner Indicator field is added to TMS reservation record (ref. HERO-64070, HERO-67705). It is also needed to show in several reports.

Requirement

In the 10 reports below,

| TMS009 Special Booking List (By Outlet)

| TMS015 Pre-Race Booking List

| TMS016 Post-Race Booking List

| TMS020 Waiting List Report

| TMS022 Master Pre-Race Booking List

| TMS024 Waiting List Extraction

| TMS025 Unsuccessful Waiting List Report (By Outlet)

| TMS035 Waiting List Report (Owner Box)

| TMS037 Master Pre-Race Booking List with Contact Information

| TMS039 Override Date Limitation for Advance Booking

To add "Syndicate Owner Indicator" field on the LEFT of "Syndicate Owner” field.

e.g.

Note: DB field is hkjc_resv_members: rmem_syndicate_owner_indicator (Please confirm with TMS team)
